project.name: apt-tennis
project.productType: Tennis club landing, membership operations, member portal and existing enrollment/authentication journeys

design.density: Operational product: 16px controls/body, 14px data, 24–28px headings; spacious landing

patterns: Selected Advanced Stats composition: dominant 2fr chart, dark real-base card and decisions aside; six exact-ledger metrics below (desktop 6, intermediate 3×2, mobile 2×3)
Native member table and operational board with the same filters
Member detail: identity, financial coverage and invoice history before administrative forms
Native disclosure sections and labelled fieldsets for existing actions
Editorial landing with existing photography, compact navigation and member/calendar links visible on mobile
Real selected theme tokens; 12px surfaces and selfhosted variable Outfit
Interactive received and confirmed-series chart: exact provider-calendar months, pointer/touch/focus readout and complete currency values
Application board uses existing admin PATCH, confirmed server state, visible errors and explicit decision dialogs; paid membership lanes remain derived

Current explicit user decision: chart first, real-base/decisions aside, then six financial metrics; this supersedes the earlier metrics-before-chart order without changing financial definitions or exact ledgers
Member table: six proportional columns without frozen overlays, all financial evidence retained, own mobile scroll and visible hint
Portal: identity, financial participation, actual next actions/access links and invoice history; editable contact separate from protected fields
Member contact detail: labelled real contact data, financial history and explicit notes before configuration; independent monitoring/email signals preserved
Approved three-word hero sequence repeats at all widths without a stop control per explicit owner decision; OS reduced motion remains static
Native member/application modal dialogs contain focus and restore the opener; persisted partial note receipts remain visible and are deduplicated without claiming unrelated edits succeeded

must: Apply the selected Amber Hearth light theme, selfhosted Outfit and official APT SVG assets
44px interactive controls, visible focus and reduced motion
Separate payment, participation, forecast and debt
Reuse native CSS and existing React components
Product headings use the UI font at 24–28px, with 16px controls and 14px data
240px sidebar, 72px collapsed; metric cards spaced by 16px with 16px radius; selected Advanced Stats chart/aside cards use 24px radius
Received cash and confirmed settlement remain separate, using the provider calendar
Content remains visible without animation; reduced motion and 44px controls apply to every surface
Use dark foreground on light amber actions and stronger muted/focus roles where the original palette misses accessible contrast
avoid: Decorative shimmer, gradient text or multi-word hero rotation
Sending repository context to external catalog
